company.notes: First trading day 2010-06-29 (IPO priced 2010-06-28), per the 2025 10-K. Reincorporated from Delaware to Texas by conversion effective 2024-06-13, after shareholders approved the redomestication at the 2024-06-13 annual meeting; filings since then cite the TBOC and a certificate of formation. Classified board with three classes and staggered three-year terms; a precatory annual-election proposal passed in 2025 but had not been implemented as of the 2026-04-30 10-K/A. Independent Chair (Robyn Denholm) since 2018-11-07, and no lead independent director since April 2019. Several directors predate the IPO: Elon and Kimbal Musk (April 2004), Ehrenpreis (May 2007).

events.summary: Elon Musk joins the board (pre-IPO; 'member of the Board since April 2004').
Kimbal Musk joins the board (pre-IPO).
Ira Ehrenpreis joins the board (pre-IPO).
Antonio Gracias joins the board (pre-IPO).
Stephen Jurvetson joins the board (pre-IPO).
Robyn Denholm elected 2014-08-04 as a Class I director, effective 2014-08-11; Audit chair, Compensation and NCG member.
James Murdoch appointed (with Linda Johnson Rice), effective 2017-07-13.
Robyn Denholm appointed Chair of the Board effective immediately, succeeding Elon Musk as chair (Chairman since April 2004).
Kathleen Wilson-Thompson appointed independent director effective 2018-12-27.
Larry Ellison appointed independent director effective 2018-12-27.
Antonio Gracias relinquishes the Lead Independent Director role; the Board determines a Lead Independent Director is not currently necessary.
Hiromichi Mizuno appointed director and Audit Committee member effective 2020-04-23.
Authorized directors increased from nine to ten for Mizuno's appointment.
Stephen Jurvetson leaves at the 2020 annual meeting (did not stand; agreed 2019-04-18).
Seats reduced from ten to nine on the expiration of Jurvetson's term, as planned in the 2020 proxy; the 2021 proxy confirms nine authorized. The resolution date itself is not disclosed.
Antonio Gracias leaves at the 2021 annual meeting (did not stand; agreed 2019-04-18).
Seats reduced from nine to eight on the expiration of Gracias's term, as planned in the 2021 proxy; the 2022 proxy confirms eight authorized. The resolution date itself is not disclosed.
Larry Ellison leaves at the 2022 annual meeting (decided in June 2022 not to stand).
Joe Gebbia appointed independent director effective 2022-09-25.
Hiromichi Mizuno leaves at the 2023 annual meeting (did not stand).
JB Straubel elected a Class I director at the 2023 annual meeting, succeeding Mizuno.
Jack Hartung appointed 2025-05-15 to the Board and Audit Committee, effective 2025-06-01.

conflicts.description: Hartung's start: the 8-K (filed 2025-05-16) and its X-post exhibit say he joined effective 2025-06-01, but his Form 3 gives 2025-06-04 as the date of the event requiring the statement. The 8-K date is used.
Murdoch's start: the 8-K says he was appointed 'on and effective as of July 13, 2017'; his Form 3 gives 2017-07-17 (the date of the announcing blog post). The 8-K date is used.

Elon Musk's end as Chairman is not dated by any filing. The 2018 proxy says he had been Chairman since April 2004; Denholm was appointed Chair 'effective immediately' in a blog post dated 2018-11-07. The end is recorded at month precision (2018-11).

Board size after Ellison left: the 2022 proxy said seats would be reduced to seven at the 2022-08-04 meeting, Gebbia's 2022-09-25 appointment 8-K says nothing about board size, and the 2023 proxy reports eight authorized. Whether the cut to seven ever took effect is not disclosed, so no size events are recorded for 2022.

Board size for Hartung: the 2024 proxy reports eight authorized and the 2025 proxy nine, but Hartung's appointment 8-K does not state an increase. The 8 -> 9 change is undated and not recorded as an event.

open_questions: No 2026 annual meeting has been held or noticed as of 2026-10-04 (no 2026 DEF 14A/PRE 14A; no 2026 8-K Item 5.07). Class I directors Elon Musk, Robyn Denholm and JB Straubel show terms 'Expires in 2026' and keep serving until successors are elected. The next proxy will settle the Class I slate.

Chairs of the Nominating and Corporate Governance and Disclosure Controls committees as of 2026-04-30: the 10-K/A table marks membership only. Per the latest proxy (2025-09-17), Ehrenpreis chairs NCG and Denholm chairs Disclosure Controls.

Declassification: a precatory shareholder proposal to elect each director annually passed on 2025-11-06, but the 2026-04-30 10-K/A still shows staggered terms (2026/2027/2028). No board action implementing it was found through 2026-10-02.
Pre-IPO start dates are disclosed only to the month (Elon and Kimbal Musk April 2004; Ehrenpreis and Gracias May 2007; Jurvetson June 2009). No filing gives a day.
Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give only point-in-time determinations (each proxy and 10-K/A), and none exists for the pre-IPO years.
Jurvetson's tenure (June 2009 - 2020-09-22) includes a leave of absence from November 2017 to April 2019. It is kept as one continuous membership.

Other-board lists come from Tesla's own bios as of each filing and are not checked against the other issuers' filings. Most bios do not say the company is public (flagged public_company_stated_in_source=false). Private boards (SpaceX, X/xAI, ZocDoc, Health Care Service Corporation, Blackbird, etc.) are excluded. The status of Murdoch's 21CF, Sky, GSK and Sotheby's seats is left 'unknown' because the bio says only 'has served'.
Committee membership is captured as point-in-time snapshots: the 2025 proxy, the 2026 10-K/A, and each departed director's last proxy. Changes between filings are not dated.

coverage.method: Roster from the 10-K/A Part III (as of 2026-04-30) and the 2025 DEF 14A, checked against every 8-K filed through 2026-10-02 (by EDGAR item codes; the last Item 5.02 was 2025-11-07, compensation only), full-text search of 8-Ks since 2025-11-01, the 2026 10-Qs, and every Form 3/4/5 filed since 2025-11-01 (no new reporting owners).

Every DEF 14A 2020-2025, the 10-K/A Part III filings of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2025 and 2026, every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019-06 through 2026-10-02, and every Form 3 since 2018 reviewed. All four departures since 2020 were annual-meeting non-renominations, dated from the 8-K Item 5.07 meeting dates.
